original.target_description: Experiment 2 task switching: accuracy, condition (switch/no-switch) × posture interaction; 30 Washington University undergraduates. Selected key postural effect; supplied locator also contains other ANOVA terms.

n.quote: Participants Thirty Washington University undergraduates each participated in one 30-min session for course credit.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions reported; ANOVA denominator df = 29 corroborates the stated sample.

replication.target_description: Experiment 2 task switching: percentage error, switching × posture interaction; final sample of 51 Texas A&M University–Commerce undergraduates.

n.quote: This resulted in a final sample size of N = 51.
n.exclusions: Six of 57 recruited participants excluded for accuracy below 80%; errors include incorrect target responses and responses exceeding 1,500 ms.

reported_success.quote: The current experiment failed to replicate the effects of posture on task-switching as reported in Smith et al. (2019).

notes: The supplied replication locator p. 6 introduces Experiment 2 but does not print its target statistics; those appear on PDF p. 7. Extracted the authors’ key switching × posture effect on accuracy/percentage error, not a main effect or RT interaction. Description does not uniquely specify accuracy versus RT, so target_match is null pending disambiguation. The replication prints partial eta squared despite requested es_type etasq. No metric conversion performed.
